Use case: productivity-visual. Generate one professional 16:9 landscape pitch slide concept for Sachet. White minimalist background, dark navy typography, restrained orange accents, fine gray borders. Informative but clear, readable projected text. No decorative icons outside actual prototype screenshots, no process timeline or numbered boxes, no orangebottomstrip.
Centered title54pt equivalent: "Built for Trust"
Main statement32pt equivalent below: "Users control what they share, can correct the evidence, and decide what happens next."
Two substantial genuine prototype screenshot panels:
LEFT caption "Privacy controls". Reference1 is actual privacy page. Crop and organize ONLY its real "Privacy, with controls." heading, Deliberate sharing card, Time limits built in card, Separate contribution card and Saved cases deletion control into a focused readable screenshot exhibit. Show accurate text: "Only material you submit enters a case. Browser screenshots are read on your device; the selected image is not uploaded." "Cases expire after seven days. Optional minimized contributions expire after 30 days. You can delete sooner." "Assessment does not opt you into research or pattern review. Contribution requires a separate choice inside each case." Saved cases "Deletion also withdraws associated report contributions." and real case deletion icon. Omit entire Where analysis happens/provider routing section to keep focus and readablesize. Do not fabricate appbuttons; crop/composite realpanels thoughtfully.
RIGHT caption "Correct the evidence". Reference2 is actual desktop screenshot with correction modal. Crop away dim background. Preserve real dialog text and controls: original stays in timeline superseded, Sachet reassesses using correction, Correctedtext contains exact syntheticINR2,000 payment message, Whatneededcorrecting input, Cancel and Savecorrection buttons. Do not change its caseamount to3,000. This is a separate synthetic example.
Bottom fullwidth four-row "Safeguards in practice" matrix:
columns "Safeguard" | "How Sachet handles it"
"Data minimization" | "Selected material only; separate consent for analyst reports"
"Incorrect assessments" | "Evidence references, visible uncertainty, correction and reassessment"
"Human control" | "Verification guidance; no automatic blocking or accusations"
"Misuse resistance" | "Case ownership checks, restricted release roles, and tested update gates"
No claim absolute privacy, automaticredactionguarantee, deployedbankintegration or securitycertification. Footer left"Sachet · Team ANKOR" center"Prototype screens · Synthetic test material" right"RAKSHAM · IIT Delhi | Statement 2". No extra tagline under flow, no baseline/API standalone notes. Accuratetextandpolishedtypography.
Variant1 Balanced trust dashboard: two equally-sized large screenshot columns undertitle, privacy left andcorrection right. Captions bold with shortorangeunderlines. Bottomthird safeguardsmatrixwithpalegrayheader and roomyfourrows. Focused screenshots dominate upperbody. No clutter.
